title: Knocked Up Syrian Penne Rigate Pasta
description: A kid-friendly Syrian dish featuring penne rigate, miso-marinate, and creamy sauce, cooked in a tandoor clay pot.
instructions: Preheat the tandoor clay pot to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cook the penne rigate pasta according to package instructions until al dente.
In a large bowl, whisk together miso paste, olive oil, and minced garlic.
Add the chopped onion to the bowl and mix until well combined.
Add the halved cherry tomatoes to the bowl and mix until well combined.
Add the cooked penne rigate pasta to the bowl and mix until well combined.
Pour in the low-sodium vegetable broth and heavy cream, and stir until the sauce is creamy.
Transfer the pasta mixture to the preheated tandoor clay pot and top with shredded parmesan cheese.
Bake for 20 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
